name: Necromancer: Frost Wyrm blasts enemies you fight every 2 seconds (#6667)
contract: Animate: Frost Wyrm 805428 reads 'flies behind the Necromancer that blasts nearby enemies every 2 sec ..., dealing ${$807339m1+(($spfr*0.702)+($INT*0.702))*0.212} Frost damage'. Without any command, once the Necromancer is in combat with an enemy, the wyrm 50177 must breathe on it about every 2 seconds: the stock Frost Breath missile 45200 shows the breath, since 807339 has no visual, and Frost Wyrm Breath 807339 (1500 base) lands as health loss. It still never casts Skeletal Mage's Command spell (#4536). #10418: the breath is a blast on nearby enemies, not a single-target hit, so a second enemy standing next to the breath target also takes Frost damage from 807339 within the same window (10-yard radius, derived from the Abomination's own Disease Cloud 802353 SpellRadius.dbc entry 13, the sibling necromancer-pet 'nearby enemies' AoE).
